videos.title: The Moody Blues -- Days of Future Passed Live
videos.description: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live.

videos.title: James Morrison: T in the Park
videos.description: T in the Park festival is a major Scottish music festival that has been held almost annually since 1994. It is named after its main sponsor, the brewing company Tennent's.

videos.title: Live at the Apple Music Festival
videos.description: Robbie Williams performs a 90-minute pop odyssey, mixing tracks from his 'Take That' era. Old or new, his songs allow him to reclaim his throne from an artist who dominates the stage.

videos.title: Lana Del Rey - Live in London 2012
videos.description: Lana Del Rey, an American singer-songwriter, performs her top tracks at the Roundhouse in London.

videos.title: Walk the Moon: Live in London 2012
videos.description: Filmed at the Roundhouse in London, Walk the Moon perform their hits including 'Shiver Shiver', 'Next in Line', 'Anna Sun', and many more.

videos.title: Guns N' Roses: Live From The O2 Arena London
videos.description: I watched this mega-production of Guns N' Roses performing live at the O2 Arena with its fans singing and moving to each song including Paradise City, Sweet Child O' Mine, November Rain and many more.

videos.title: AC/DC: Live at the Circus Krone
videos.description: The band performs in Munich, Germany; songs include "Back in Black," "Highway to Hell," and "Whole Lotta Rosie.".

videos.title: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
videos.description: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

videos.title: Lenny Kravitz -- Live at the iTunes Festival
videos.description: Lenny Kravitz performs at the iTunes Festival on 26 September 2014, giving his audience at the Roundhouse, London, a great concert.

videos.title: AC/DC: Live at the Circus Krone
videos.description: The band performs in Munich, Germany; songs include "Back in Black," "Highway to Hell," and "Whole Lotta Rosie.".

videos.title: Def Leppard: And there will be a next time
videos.description: A mind-blowing audio and visual extravaganza, featuring their biggest hits; songs include "Pour Some Sugar On Me," "Hysteria," "Rocket," "Photograph," "Bringin' on the Heartbreak," "Rock of Ages," "Animal" and more.

videos.description: Rock musician John Mellencamp performs at the Chicago Theatre: song selections include "Small Town," "Check It Out," "Rain on the Scarecrow," "Paper in Fire" and "Cherry Bomb"; from February 17, 2015.

videos.description: David Gilmour, the voice and guitar of Pink Floyd performs live at the Royal Albert Hall. Performing hits from his newly released album 'On an Island' and a selection of hits from throughout Pink Floyd's 40-year career, David Gilmour is joined on stage by Pink Floyd keyboardist Richard Wright, Pink Floyd's Dick Parry on sax, Phil Manzanera from Roxy Music, and other special contributors.
